notes: ACCESS: plain direct fetch of loaf.com throughout (probe.py / requests) - no WAF, no proxy needed, every URL HTTP 200. robots.txt names no Claude/anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot agent. TREE: taken from the rendered mega-menu in the homepage HTML (nav.header__navigation), cross-checked against https://loaf.com/sitemap.xml (943 locs) and against each listing page's own 'type' facet. Six top departments: Sofas & Chairs, Beds & Mattresses, 'Tables, Chairs & Storage', Homewares, Discover More, OUTLET. QTY METHOD: every listing embeds a data-data JSON blob carrying "totalResults". On the paginated listings the rendered header ('1-33 of 82 results' on /all-sofas, '1-34 of 38 results' on /all-footstools) matched totalResults exactly. On every leaf I additionally enumerated all product tiles (the data-ee id on each listing-card__media-link, following ?page= to the end) and the tile count equalled totalResults on all 25 leaves - so each qty is verified three ways where paginated, two ways otherwise. Every leaf was then re-fetched in a separate second pass: zero drift. h1 and rel=canonical were checked on each leaf to rule out silent parent-serving; the one mismatch is /bedroom-furniture/dressing-tables-and-stools, whose canonical is /bedroom-furniture/desk-dressing-table (same 2 products, same h1) - the canonical is what I recorded. NOT USED: the facet option counts inside the same JSON are stock-item (product x fabric x size) counts and are wildly inflated (e.g. type 'standard-sofas': 35167 inside an 82-product listing) - never used for any qty. HIERARCHY: Sitting room (25+18+2+2=47), Kitchen (12+31=43), Bedroom (4+18+3+2+5=32) and Chairs (10+30+24=64) children each sum exactly to their parent total and match the parent's own type facet, so those parents are grouping rows. The Beds children (9+6+28+3) union to exactly the 40 items of /all-beds - French beds crosscuts Wooden/Upholstered, which is why the raw sum is 46 - so they are recorded as children under a Beds grouping row. Sofas children (modular 16, corner 22, chaise 20, sofa beds 13; union 60 distinct) do NOT cover all 82 of /all-sofas: the site's own type facet has a 'Standard sofa' bucket with no navigable URL, so roughly 22 standard sofas are not represented by any leaf row. /all-sofas was still kept as a grouping row per the parent-is-never-a-leaf rule rather than double-counting. Footstools and Headboards are recorded as leaves because their sub-pages are stale attribute views (see their flags); those two standalone leaves are emitted FIRST, ahead of every grouping row, so that positional reading cannot mistake them for children of an unrelated group. EXCLUDED and why: Mattresses /all-beds/mattresses (5) - bedding per brief. All 'In-stock ...' pages (in-stock sofas 325, chairs 97, beds 182, footstools 37, headboards 17, /furniture/in-stock-furniture 120) - availability filters, and they count stock items not catalogue products, a different unit entirely. OUTLET / Bag-a-bargain branch - clearance. /all-wooden-furniture (104) and /all-sofas/velvet-sofas (70) - material filter views. /tables (57, h1 '15% off all tables'), /sofas-chairs (168), the colour pages (/blue-sofas etc), /2-3-seater-sofas and /4-5-6-7-seater-sofas, and all /edits/* and /discover/* - promotional, size, colour and editorial landing pages. /all-headboards/curved-headboards and the seven footstool attribute pages - see flags. /additional-covers (21) - furniture covers/parts. /underbed-storage-new (2) - standalone storage, not in the nav. The whole Homewares branch is out of scope (its type facet is Soft furnishings / Kitchen & Tableware / Soft accessories / Home accessories): rugs, cushions, seat pads, beanbags, bedding, bed linen, duvets, blankets, quilts, slippers, socks, hot water bottles, mugs, trays, mirrors, storage baskets, dog beds. COVERAGE CHECK: grepped all 943 sitemap locs for garden/outdoor/patio/office/kids/nursery/crib/bookcase/cabinet/dresser/console/dining/vanity/bathroom - Loaf has no outdoor, office, kids or bathroom furniture line at all, so nothing is missing on those fronts.
